identity: An editorial transformation: a true main claim remains while the affected person, deadline and alternative are physically removed; a source comparison restores inspectable consequences.
typography: One shared Red Hat Display scene title; meaningful object labels in Red Hat Display at 32px or larger; Red Hat Text captions, one full sentence at a time.
composition: Four book-specific scenes; task environments and causal operations, deliberate scale changes and fixed readable label lanes. Enacted figures use distinct task roles and timed expressions. Conceptual diagrams remain only where they explain the source mechanism.
themes: Flat Color, Light and Dark backgrounds, with explicit dark contrast for original palette fills and text.
motion: Measured sentence pauses; articulated gestures and scene-specific expression states are synchronized to speech cues. Quiet holds preserve attention. No audible automatic preview.
